compiled: 2026-11-24. Scope cut mid-research to a demo/test vehicle: verified basics, schedule, 6 known issues, one NHTSA recall pass, one diagnosis plan.

vehicle.trim: unknown (Custom XVS650 / Classic XVS650A / Silverado XVS650AT)
vehicle.spec_source_note: Primary source is the Yamaha XVS650Y/XVS650AY owner manual (model year 2009, 3B7-28199-23, printed Apr 2008), a public copy on cyclechaos.com (robots.txt allows reference use). It covers the Custom (XVS650) and Classic (XVS650A). It is a non-US edition (it lists an immobilizer, a carburetor heater fuse and km-based intervals), so items marked "verify (US 2007)" may differ on a US 2007 bike. The engine and drivetrain are unchanged 1998-2016 (general knowledge). The Silverado is not covered by this manual.
vehicle.engine: 649 cc air-cooled 4-stroke SOHC 70-degree V-twin, 2 valves per cylinder, bore x stroke 81.0 x 63.0 mm, compression 9.0:1, electric start, wet sump (manual p.9-1; 70 degrees and 2 valves/cyl from moto-data.net)
vehicle.carburetion: Mikuni BDS28 x 2 (manual p.9-1). Some listings say "BSR28"; the manual says BDS28. Verify the stamped carb type on a US 2007 bike.
vehicle.clutch: Wet, multiple-disc, cable operated (manual p.9-1; cable from the chart item "clutch: check operation, adjust", p.7-2)
vehicle.transmission: Constant-mesh 5-speed, left foot shift. Ratios 2.714 / 1.900 / 1.458 / 1.167 / 0.967; primary 68/38 (1.789) (manual p.9-1, 9-2)
vehicle.final_drive: Shaft drive, secondary ratio 19/18 x 32/11 (3.071) (manual p.9-1). No chain or belt.
vehicle.ignition: TCI (digital transistor-controlled ignition); charging by AC magneto (stator) through a regulator/rectifier (manual p.9-3)
vehicle.battery: GT12B-4, 12 V 10.0 Ah, VRLA (sealed) per the 2009 manual (p.9-3). Common aftermarket cross: Yuasa YT12B-BS (general knowledge, verify fitment). Verify against the battery fitted: the request guessed YTX14-BS, which is NOT what the manual lists.
vehicle.fuel: Unleaded, RON 91 or higher (about 87 AKI pump octane in the US, general knowledge). Tank 16.0 L (4.23 US gal), reserve 3.0 L (0.79 US gal) (manual p.4-10, 9-1)
vehicle.fuel_cock: Manual fuel cock with OFF / ON / RES positions (manual p.4-11, 4-12). NOT a vacuum petcock on this manual's bikes: turn it to OFF whenever the engine is not running. Verify on the US 2007 bike.
vehicle.choke: Starter (choke) knob on the carburetors (enricher circuit); do not use it for more than 3 minutes (manual p.4-12)
vehicle.spark_plug: NGK DPR7EA-9 or Denso X22EPR-U9, gap 0.8-0.9 mm (0.031-0.035 in) (manual p.9-1)
vehicle.idle_speed: 1150-1250 rpm, engine warm, set with the throttle stop screw (manual p.7-14)
vehicle.valve_clearance_cold: NOT VERIFIED. Commonly quoted for the XVS650: intake 0.07-0.12 mm, exhaust 0.12-0.17 mm (general knowledge). The Yamaha service manual page on manualslib (p.66) confirms the check is done cold at TDC compression, but I could not read the values. Verify in the service manual before adjusting.
vehicle.engine_oil: API SG or higher, JASO MA. Viscosity by temperature: SAE 10W-30, 10W-40, 15W-40, 20W-40 or 20W-50 (chart also shows 10W-50). No "CD" diesel oils and no "Energy Conserving II" oils (clutch slip). (manual p.7-10, 9-1)
vehicle.engine_oil_capacity: Without filter change 2.60 L (2.75 US qt); with filter change 2.80 L (2.96 US qt) (manual p.7-10, 9-1). Total dry capacity not given in the owner manual (verify in the service manual).
vehicle.oil_filter: Cartridge element under a cover (2 cover bolts, 10 Nm), with an O-ring (manual p.7-9, 7-10). Aftermarket: Hiflofiltro HF145 (lists Yamaha OEM 5JX-13440-00, 4X7-13440-xx, 2H0-13440-90, 583-13440-10 as replaced numbers) and K&N KN-145. The OEM number for the 2007 US bike was not confirmed (verify; the request guessed 5GH-13440, which I found no source for).
vehicle.shared_sump: Yes. Wet sump; the manual says "the engine oil also lubricates the clutch", and the transmission runs in the same engine oil (no separate transmission oil in the spec list). Only the final drive has its own oil. (manual p.7-10, 9-1)
vehicle.final_gear_oil: SAE 80 API GL-4 hypoid gear oil (GL-5 or GL-6 hypoid also allowed), 0.19 L (0.20 US qt). Fill to the brim of the filler hole, bike upright, cold. (manual p.7-11, 9-1)
vehicle.fork_oil: From a manualslib copy of the XVS650 service manual (search snippet, OCR messy): Yamaha fork oil 10W, 454 cm3 (15.3 US oz) per leg, level 114 mm. VERIFY before use: I could not read the page itself.
vehicle.brakes: Front: single hydraulic disc, right hand. Rear: drum, right foot (manual p.9-2, covers Custom and Classic). The Silverado shares the Classic chassis, so a rear drum is expected (general knowledge, verify).

tires.custom_XVS650: Front 100/90-19M/C 57S on 19 x MT2.50; rear 170/80-15M/C 77S on 15 x MT3.50. OE Bridgestone Exedra L309 / G546.
tires.classic_XVS650A: Front 130/90-16M/C 67S on 16 x MT3.00; rear 170/80-15M/C 77S. OE Dunlop D404F / D404G.
tires.pressures_cold: Custom: front 200 kPa (29 psi) solo and loaded. Classic: front 225 kPa (33 psi) solo and loaded. Rear, both: 225 kPa (33 psi) for 0-90 kg (0-198 lb) load, 250 kPa (36 psi) above 90 kg. Max load Custom 180 kg (397 lb), Classic 200 kg (441 lb).

torque_specs.spark_plugs: Not in my extracted text; 17.5 Nm (13 ft-lb) is commonly quoted for this plug size (general knowledge, verify)
torque_specs.axle_nuts: Not verified; see the service manual

vehicle.dimensions_weights: Custom: 233 kg (514 lb) with oil and fuel, seat 695 mm, wheelbase 1610 mm. Classic: 247 kg (545 lb), seat 710 mm, wheelbase 1625 mm (manual p.9-1, 2009 non-US spec)
vehicle.fuses: Main 30 A; headlight 15 A; signaling 10 A; ignition 10 A (manual p.9-3)

variant_differences.custom_XVS650: 19 in spoke front wheel (100/90-19), 15 in rear (170/80-15), footpegs, shorter bobbed fenders, lighter (233 kg wet per 2009 manual), front tire 29 psi. Rear drum brake.
variant_differences.classic_XVS650A: 16 in fat front tire (130/90-16), deep valanced fenders, floorboards and heel-toe shifter (general knowledge), heavier (247 kg wet), front tire 33 psi, higher max load. Rear drum brake.
variant_differences.silverado_XVS650AT: Classic plus windshield, leather saddlebags and passenger backrest (general knowledge; not in the manual I read). Weight higher than the Classic (verify). Same engine, drivetrain, fluids and rear drum (verify).
variant_differences.how_to_tell: 19 in front wheel = Custom. Fat 16 in front, floorboards and big fenders = Classic. Classic plus windshield and bags from the factory = Silverado. The model code is on the VIN/model label (frame neck / under the seat).

owner_manual_fluids.fuel: Unleaded RON 91+, 16.0 L tank, 3.0 L reserve (p.4-10, 9-1)

owner_manual_schedule.source_note: Two sources. (1) The 2009 non-US owner manual chart (p.7-2 to 7-5): 1,000 km (600 mi), then every 10,000 km (6,000 mi), plus an annual check; repeat from 10,000 km after 50,000 km. Text extraction lost the column positions of the check marks, so I cannot say which items fall in which column. (2) maintenanceschedule.com, which says its table comes from the US owner manual: columns 4,000 / 8,000 / 12,000 / 16,000 / 20,000 mi = 6 / 12 / 18 / 24 / 30 months. The schedule below uses (2) for intervals and (1) for the fixed date items. The US initial 600 mi service is general knowledge for US Yamahas (verify).
owner_manual_schedule.us_chart_summary: Every 4,000 mi/6 mo: oil change, plug check/clean, air filter clean, carb sync and idle, brakes, hoses, fuel hoses, clutch, final gear leak check, cables, wheels, tires, wheel and steering bearings, shock, fork, side stand/switch, crankcase breather, exhaust, lights. Every 8,000 mi/12 mo: oil filter, new plugs, swingarm check. 16,000 mi/24 mo: final gear oil change, repack steering and swingarm bearings. 20,000 mi: fuel filter. Valve clearance: 26,600 mi per that page (verify). https://maintenanceschedule.com/?p=1749
owner_manual_schedule.fixed_date_items: Brake fluid plus master cylinder/caliper seals every 2 years; brake hoses every 4 years (p.7-5)
owner_manual_schedule.non_us_chart_extra: Steering bearings lubricate every 20,000 km (12,000 mi); swingarm lubricate every 50,000 km (30,000 mi) (p.7-3)
owner_manual_schedule.pre_ride: Final gear case must be checked for oil leakage before each ride (p.7-11)
owner_manual_schedule.storage: Fuel cock OFF, drain both float bowls, fill tank with stabilizer, oil in the plug bores, lube cables, remove and charge battery (p.8-3, 8-4)

recalls.summary: NHTSA files 2007 V Star models as "V STAR" (one model name for all displacements). recallsByVehicle for YAMAHA / V STAR / 2007 returns Count 0. Also 0 for V STAR 650, XVS650, V STAR 650 CLASSIC/CUSTOM/SILVERADO, V-STAR 650, VSTAR 650. NHTSA's 2007 Yamaha recall model list (https://api.nhtsa.gov/products/vehicle/models?modelYear=2007&make=YAMAHA&issueType=r) has no 650-specific entry. Other years list "XVS650" (1998, 2010) and "SVS650" (2000, 2005) under recalls, but I did not check those campaigns against a 2007 bike.
recalls.remedy: Still run the VIN at nhtsa.gov/recalls and ask a Yamaha dealer: the API search by model name can miss campaigns filed under another name (general knowledge).

known_issues.title: Gummed carburetors / clogged pilot jets after storage (ethanol fuel)
known_issues.symptoms: Hard start, runs only on choke, will not idle, dies a few seconds after starting, fuel smell in the airbox. A used 2008 650 that sat 6 months cranked and died after 3-4 s.
known_issues.fix: Drain bowls; fresh fuel; remove carbs and clean pilot jets and passages (carb cleaner, fine wire, compressed air), new O-rings/gaskets; then sync and set idle. Prevent with fuel cock OFF, stabilizer and draining bowls for storage (manual p.8-3).
known_issues.cost_shop: $50-150 per motoryk; a full two-carb clean and sync is often more (general knowledge)

known_issues.title: Regulator/rectifier failure, melted connector, battery drain
known_issues.symptoms: Battery goes flat, slow cranking, charging voltage low or over 15 V, melted or browned R/R or stator connector.
known_issues.fix: Test charging voltage at the battery (about 13.5-15 V at 5,000 rpm is a typical target, general knowledge, verify in the service manual); test the R/R diodes and stator; replace R/R and/or clean or replace the connector.

known_issues.title: Oil leak from a cracked neutral switch housing (left side of the engine)
known_issues.symptoms: Oil running down the left side and onto the kickstand; drips on the floor. Often mistaken for a case-half leak.
known_issues.fix: Remove the two left covers, take out the 3 Torx bolts and replace the plastic neutral switch with a new O-ring.

known_issues.title: Final drive (shaft) oil leak
known_issues.symptoms: Oil on the final gear case, rear wheel or tire. NHTSA complaint 10627874 (2007 "V STAR", displacement unknown): final drive leaking out of the housing.
known_issues.fix: Check the level and the drain/filler bolt washers first; a seal leak needs a dealer (manual). Oil on the tire is a crash risk.

known_issues.title: Fork seal leaks
known_issues.symptoms: Oil film on the fork tubes below the seals, oil on the brake caliper, soft front end.
known_issues.fix: New fork seals and dust wipers, fresh fork oil.

known_issues.title: Rear drum brake wear and adjustment
known_issues.symptoms: Long pedal travel, weak rear brake; the wear indicator on the drum at the limit.
known_issues.fix: Adjust pedal free play; replace shoes at the limit.

symptom_diagnosis.symptom: Hard starting / will not idle / dies without choke

likely_causes.cause: Fuel cock in OFF, or tank on reserve and near empty
Stale fuel / varnish in the float bowls
likely_causes.how_to_check: Smell; drain a float bowl into a clear jar
Runs on choke only, idle drops off as choke goes off
Resting voltage (12.6 V full, general knowledge), cranking speed

likely_causes.cause: Air leak at cracked intake boots
likely_causes.how_to_check: Look for cracks; spray test at idle

symptom_diagnosis.symptom: Battery keeps going flat / slow crank

likely_causes.how_to_check: Charge, rest 12 h, load test (general knowledge)
Charging voltage at 5,000 rpm; connector condition; diode test
Stator resistance and AC output (service manual values)

symptom_diagnosis.symptom: Oil on the left side / kickstand

likely_causes.how_to_check: Remove left covers, look at the switch

symptom_diagnosis.symptom: Oil at the rear wheel / final drive

likely_causes.cause: Final drive seal or bolt washer leak, overfilled case
likely_causes.how_to_check: Clean, ride, recheck; level at the filler brim

recommendations.item: Confirm the variant (19 in front wheel = Custom; 16 in fat front + floorboards = Classic; plus factory windshield/bags = Silverado) and read the model code off the VIN label
recommendations.why: Tire size and front pressure differ by variant (29 vs 33 psi)

recommendations.item: Read both tire DOT date codes; replace any tire older than about 5-6 years or cracked
recommendations.why: Tube-type tires on an old bike; age matters more than tread (general knowledge)
recommendations.cost: $0 to check; $250-450 a pair fitted (general knowledge)

recommendations.item: Run the VIN at nhtsa.gov/recalls and with a Yamaha dealer
recommendations.why: API by model name found 0 recalls, but VIN lookup is authoritative

recommendations.item: Pre-ride check: tire pressure, final gear leak check, brakes, lights, oil level
recommendations.why: Manual requires a final gear leak check before each ride

recommendations.item: If service history is unknown: oil + HF145 filter, final gear oil, brake fluid (DOT 4), new DPR7EA-9 plugs, clean air filter
recommendations.why: Cheap baseline; all are time-based too

recommendations.item: Load-test the battery and measure charging voltage
recommendations.why: R/R failure is the main electrical weak point

recommendations.item: Left-side oil (neutral switch), fork seals, final drive leaks, rear drum wear
Carb clean if it is hard to start or only runs on choke after fresh fuel
recommendations.why: Most common storage problem on this bike

recommendations.item: Car oils labeled Energy Conserving II or diesel CD oils
